title: Console request decision lattice and priority exchange
creator: Aisha Rahman
description:
Summary: Build a decision lattice and an operational ‘priority exchange’ to standardize how Console reporting and export requests from enterprise customers are triaged, scored, and handed off to engineering or solutions teams. This ticket defines the rubric, intake form updates, escalations, and a lightweight tooling spec for an automated priority suggestion that surface to PMs and SREs.

Context: We receive a steady stream of non-bug feature requests from enterprise tenants asking for ad-hoc exports, tenant-level cost breakdowns, per-token consumption dashboards, and custom dashboard connectors. Current handling is inconsistent across SE, PM, and Support; duplicates and under-scored asks frequently slip past SLA lanes. The goal is a repeatable decision lattice (multi-dimensional scoring) + a Priority Exchange workflow where requests are offered to resourcing lanes (self-serve, concierge, paid engagement) and tagged with delivery expectations.

Objectives: 
- Create a transparent multi-criteria scoring lattice (signals: tenant size, legal/SLA needs, security/regulatory, incremental revenue, implementation effort, one-off vs reusable).
- Update intake form to capture minimal structured signals and attach supporting artifacts (sample query, number of rows, retention needs, regulatory tags).
- Define routing outcomes and service lanes (Self-Serve Template, Scheduled Export, Concierge Build, Paid Professional Services).
- Prototype a UI in the Console for intake analysts to accept/adjust automated score and assign lane.
- Document escalation rules for P0/P1 enterprise asks and a 48-hour triage SLA.

Intake Form - required fields (proposal): 
- Tenant workspace ID (string)
- Use case summary (1-2 sentences)
- Data scope: metrics/fields requested (text)
- Expected frequency: ad-hoc | daily | weekly | monthly | real-time
- Estimated rows per export (numeric)
- Compliance tags: PCI | HIPAA | SOC2 | None (multi-select)
- Business outcome: revenue | cost-savings | legal | operations | other
- Attaching artifact links: example dashboard / SQL / sample file (URLs)

Priority Lattice - scoring dimensions and suggested weights (prototype): 
- Customer tier (Enterprise=40, Mid-market=20, Starter=5)
- Revenue signal (ARR impact forecasted: 0-30)
- Security/compliance (HIPAA/PCI=30)
- Reusability (one-off=0, reusable pattern=20)
- Implementation complexity (low=0, medium=-10, high=-25)
- Time-sensitivity (regulatory/legal deadline=30, otherwise 0)

Scoring to lanes mapping (example): 
- 70+ -> Concierge Build (SLA 4 weeks) or Paid PS; require EPD + Solutions sign-off
- 45-69 -> Scheduled Export / Product Backlog (SLA 8-12 weeks)
- 20-44 -> Self-Serve Template / Playbook (SLA 4-8 weeks)
- <20 -> Defer / FAQ / Low-touch guidance (no guaranteed delivery)

Routing and handoff: 
- Automated score generated on intake. Intake analyst reviews and can adjust with a reason (free text) before committing to lane.
- Handoff bundles created (artifact link, score, expected deliverable, SLA, assignee) and posted to the Console ‘Request Queue’ visible to engineering squads and solutions team.
- For Concierge lane: create scoped PRD and Solutions kickoff within 3 business days.

Acceptance criteria (must be met for closure): 
- Intake form updated in Console prototype and backend captures required signals (validated with 5 sample customer requests).
- A documented scoring lattice available in Confluence with examples and clear mapping to lanes.
- Priority Exchange prototype (spreadsheet + simple API) that can accept intake and produce lane recommendations.
- A 48-hour SLA tracker added to Zendesk ticket routing and a sample runbook for analysts.
- Stakeholder approvals: Solutions, Sales Engineering, Legal (if compliance flagged).

Open questions / Risks: 
- Weight calibration: how often should weights be re-tuned and what telemetry will we use to validate? (proposal: quarterly review tied to delivery outcomes).
- Edge cases for composite requests (multiple compliance tags + very large data volumes).
- Potential need for budgeted PS line item for high-effort concierge work; coordinate with GTM pricing.

Next steps: 
1) Workshop with Sales Engineering and Solutions (invite list: 6 people) - scheduled 2026-03-05.
2) Design low-fidelity intake form and Console UI flow (Design owner: Dana Chu) - prototype by 2026-03-12.
3) Backend intake schema and scoring lambda (Eng owner: Marco Silva) - initial prototype by 2026-03-22.
4) Run 2-week pilot with top 8 enterprise tenants to validate scoring and lane mapping.

Related artifacts and links: 
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CONSOLE/pages/priority-lattice-proposal (draft)
- Mockups: Google Drive link - https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleMockups
- Sample Zendesk trigger: https://redwood/acct/zendesk/triggers/console-intake (internal)
- Existing backlog PRD for exports: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/4321
acceptance_criteria: Updated intake form stored in backend schema and collects required signals for 5 sample requests
Confluence decision lattice doc with lane mappings and 3 worked examples
Priority Exchange prototype that ingests an intake and outputs recommended lane and score
48-hour triage SLA implemented in Zendesk routing for enterprise-class requests
Stakeholder sign-off from Solutions and Sales Engineering
comments: 2026-03-02 - Marco Silva: Met with infra; backend schema will reuse existing request table. Will add new columns for compliance_tags and estimated_rows. ETA for schema migration: 2026-03-15.

2026-03-04 - Dana Chu (Design): Low-fi mocks completed. Putting two alternative flows: (A) inline score suggestion during submit; (B) post-submit analyst review. Preferring B for initial rollout to avoid confusing customers.
2026-03-05 - Aisha Rahman: Workshop notes: Sales Eng asked for a revenue multiplier if request is part of deal expansion. Decision: include optional ARR field to capture that signal.
2026-03-07 - Legal (via Slack): If compliance_tags include HIPAA/PCI we must insert a mandatory legal review step before concierge lane assignment.

2026-03-09 - Marco Silva: Added a lightweight Priority Exchange prototype (Google Sheet + script) and ran 6 historical tickets through it to compare recommended vs actual outcomes. Preliminary precision 0.67 for Concierge lane; will iterate weights.
2026-03-10 - Aisha Rahman: Kickoff scheduled with Pricing to define PS pricing floor for Concierge. Also added sample telemetry events to track SLA compliance and lane conversion rates.
